caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden wall clock with a dark brown frame featuring carved decorative patterns at the top and along the vertical sides. The clock has two distinct sections: the upper section contains a large, round, white clock face with black Roman numerals, black hour and minute hands, and a smaller dial marked with circles, surrounded by a golden line. The face is bordered by four decorated triangular corner elements, each featuring a floral or leaf motif in green and yellow. The lower section is divided into three parts: two rectangular panels on the left and right, each displaying a green building with yellow windows and a blue roof, positioned in a landscape with grass and trees; and a central narrow vertical band with intricate gold and black geometric and floral patterns. The background of the image is an off-white or beige color, and in the lower right corner of the image, the name "MARIE FAMULARO" and a set of dates/numbers are written or printed in small, neat letters.
title: Wall Clock
